english_source_note: Kronecker's Theorem, Dirichlet's Theorem, and Applications

strategies.strategy_name_en: Find Two Close Fractional Parts and Subtract
strategies.summary_en: To prove Dirichlet-type approximation, look for two multiples $q_1\alpha$ and $q_2\alpha$ whose fractional parts are very close. Their difference then produces an integer $q_2-q_1$ with controlled size and small distance to an integer.
strategies.applicability: This strategy applies when one wants to prove existence of integers $q$ such that $||q\alpha||$ is small, especially via pigeonhole arguments on fractional parts modulo $1$.
strategies.callout_body: 那么根据这个观察，我们如果能在正整数的某个子集$A_n$里面，找到两个$q_1,q_2$使得$q_1\alpha,q_2\alpha$他们彼此之间模1的余数的距离小于$\frac{1}{n}$，并且保证$1\leq q_2-q_1\leq n$那么我们也就完成了对Dirichlet定理的证明。
